novelty_flags.label: Theorems 1 and 4; related_work strict-extension language
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposed finite-action, fixed-dimensional model is not a strict superset of FangRidderXie2026's discrete/continuous/mixed-treatment framework; describe the result as a uniform-in-preference extension on their common regular finite-action submodel, unless an inclusion theorem is supplied.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 7 and 25, framework definition and Theorem 5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper explicitly covers discrete, continuous, and mixed treatments, while Theorem 5 gives the fixed-penalty DR optimizer limit and fixed-penalty quadratic regret limit.
The paper develops simultaneous confidence bands for many functional parameters using approximately orthogonal scores and multiplier bootstrap resampling of estimated scores.
The manuscript supplies uniform lower-confidence/reporting guarantees and regret guarantees for risk-aware policy selection under its Gaussian-approximation conditions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace every unqualified claim to “strictly contain” FangRidderXie2026 with a common-submodel statement, and include an explicit map from the anchor's fixed penalty to c and from its rule class to the finite-action softmax subclass.

Make the field-level advance sharper by stating a finite-sample or explicit asymptotic coverage error for the tube, tied to the replacement remainder and multiplier approximation, rather than only a liminf guarantee.
Add a worked commitment-savings-style finite-action example computing the common-multiplier tube and quadratic-regret band, showing the covariance loss from pointwise separate intervals.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Fang comparison to an explicitly common-submodel uniform-in-preference extension, then advance the field-level joint-tube kernel to Stage 0.
